title: kbext.py loads a group's extender for an extension point from the settings layers or an it_ops_kb entry point, and refuses a missing or version-mismatched one by name
goal: _tools/kbext.py (standard library only) holds API_VERSION and load(point, root): it reads extensions.<point> as module:attr from kbsettings.effective, puts each extension_paths directory (relative to the file that named it) on sys.path, and else takes the one entry point of group it_ops_kb.<point> from importlib.metadata.entry_points(group=...); a module's KBEXT_REQUIRES (a comma list of >=, <, == bounds on MAJOR.MINOR) must hold API_VERSION. kbext.py resolve POINT --root WS prints the point, module:attr, the layer and file that named it, exit 0; a missing module or attribute, two entry points for one point, or a version outside KBEXT_REQUIRES exits 2 with one line naming the point, the module and the layer. kbext.py call POINT --root WS --json ARGS calls the extender and prints its result as JSON.

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(e/"grp_lane.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\ndef path_lane(path):\n    return \"code\" if path.endswith(\".py\") else \"content\"\n",encoding="utf-8")
(e/"grp_bad.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=99\"\ndef path_lane(path):\n    return \"content\"\n",encoding="utf-8")
s=lambda m: (d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"lane":m},"extension_paths":["ext"]}),encoding="utf-8")
k=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py",*a,"--root",str(d)],capture_output=True,text=True)
s("grp_lane:path_lane"); r=k("resolve","lane"); assert r.returncode==0 and "grp_lane:path_lane" in r.stdout and "clone" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
r=k("call","lane","--json",json.dumps(["_tools/x.py"])); assert r.returncode==0 and json.loads(r.stdout)=="code", (r.stdout,r.stderr)
s("grp_bad:path_lane"); r=k("resolve","lane"); assert r.returncode==2 and "lane" in r.stderr and "grp_bad" in r.stderr, (r.returncode,r.stderr)
s("grp_none:path_lane"); r=k("resolve","lane"); assert r.returncode==2 and "grp_none" in r.stderr, (r.returncode,r.stderr)
